senses.gloss: ch. same, to curve. *Targ. Ps. LIX, 5 עד לא עַוְויָן ed. Lag. (oth. ed. על לא עַוְיָן) without making a curve (deviation) (Ms. עֲוָויָא).
to be wrong. Ib. CVI, 6 (ed. Lag. עותנא, v. עֲוַת).
